issue.title: bob-docs calls a stale gitignored mount index.md a 'committed landing page' and fails docs-check
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-iq.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, note #1) and triaged by the bob-cli-iq land agent. Not caused by epic bob-cli-iq.

## What is wrong

`just docs-check` (`bob-docs check`) fails in a reused workspace with:

    bob-docs: error: mount 'bob-plugins' -> 'reference/plugins': source ships index.md, which collides with the committed landing page …/docs/reference/plugins/index.md; never silently replace an authored landing page

The file it calls "committed" is not committed. `docs/reference/plugins/*` and `docs/develop/plugins/*` are gitignored (`.gitignore` lines 4 and 7), and `git ls-files` lists nothing there. The files are copies left over from an older docs run (mtime 2026-11-01 08:30) that wrote mount output before the current mount manifest (`mount-manifest.json`) knew about them.

## Root cause

`tools/docs/bob_docs/mounts.py::validate_mount_targets`, in the `plan.source_hub` branch:

    if index.exists() and str(hub) not in owned:
        raise DocsError(... "collides with the committed landing page" ...)

It treats "exists and not in the manifest" as "authored and committed". It never checks whether the index is tracked, even though `tracked = _tracked_files(root)` is already computed. It also never checks whether the path is gitignored (`path_ignored(root, index_rel)`).

## Repro

1. In a bob-cli workspace with docs mounts configured, delete `mount-manifest.json` (from `context_from_root(root).output_dir`) or use a workspace with Nov-1-era mount output. Leave the old copied files under `docs/reference/plugins/` and `docs/develop/plugins/`.
2. Run `just docs-check`. It fails with the collision error above.
3. Move every `git status --ignored --porcelain docs/` path aside and rerun. `docs-check: all implemented gates passed` (observed 2026-11-08 on master 984f8196: 447 passed, 1 skipped).

## Suggested fix

When the index is untracked and gitignored, do not call it a committed landing page. Either treat it as stale mount output (same rules as the existing stale-output cleanup, which already refuses to delete non-ignored files), or raise an actionable error naming the cleanup, e.g. `git clean -fX docs/<target>/`. Add a tools/docs test: an ignored, untracked, unmanifested `index.md` under a source-hub mount target.

## Impact

False docs-check failures in long-lived agent workspaces. bob-cli-iq.6 reported this as "just docs-check fails on clean master". That misdiagnosis cost a phase agent and a land agent investigation time.

task_type_fields.impact: False docs-check failures in reused agent workspaces, misreported as master failures.
task_type_fields.repro: In a workspace whose docs/reference/plugins/ or docs/develop/plugins/ holds untracked, gitignored copies not in mount-manifest.json, run just docs-check: it fails with 'collides with the committed landing page'. Moving the ignored docs/ paths aside makes it pass.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-iq.6 proposed this follow-up after just docs-check failed. Landing triage found the failure is a false positive from stale, ignored mount output that validate_mount_targets misreads as a committed landing page.
